# Schema: netflow_v1 (version 1)

<!-- GENERATED by `uv run netanomaly schema-doc` from src/netanomaly/contracts/netflow_v1.yaml. Do not edit by hand; tests fail if this file is stale. -->

**0 of 42 fields are validated** against exporter/collector documentation. Every other meaning is an inference from field names, NetFlow/IPFIX conventions and data profiling.

- **validated**: meaning confirmed from the collector's documentation.
- **confidence**: strength of the *inference* (high / medium / low / unknown). Only high/medium may feed features.
- **use**: entity (grouping key), feature, derive (input to derived columns), provenance (traceability only), exclude.

| raw column | canonical | type | validated | confidence | use | meaning / evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `src_id_addr` | `src_ip` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | high | entity | Source IPv4 address (sourceIPv4Address). 'id_addr' looks like a typo for 'ip_addr'. |
| `src_subnet` | `src_subnet` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | high | entity | Source network in CIDR form; derivable from src_ip + src_mask. |
| `src_port` | `src_port` | INTEGER | **UNVERIFIED** | high | derive | Source transport port (sourceTransportPort). 0 for ICMP. Never used as a magnitude. |
| `src_mask` | `src_mask` | SMALLINT | **UNVERIFIED** | high | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | Source prefix length (sourceIPv4PrefixLength). Constant 24 in mock data. |
| `src_as` | `src_as` | BIGINT | **UNVERIFIED** | high | provenance | Source BGP autonomous system number. Values are private-use ASNs (64512-65534). |
| `dist_id_addr` | `dst_ip` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | high | entity | Destination IPv4 address. 'dist' = destination. |
| `dist_subnet` | `dst_subnet` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | high | entity | Destination network in CIDR form. |
| `dist_port` | `dst_port` | INTEGER | **UNVERIFIED** | high | derive | Destination transport port. Identifies the service (443, 53, 445...). Used as class/rarity, never as a magnitude. |
| `dist_mask` | `dst_mask` | SMALLINT | **UNVERIFIED** | high | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | Destination prefix length. Constant 24 in mock data. |
| `dist_as` | `dst_as` | BIGINT | **UNVERIFIED** | high | provenance | Destination ASN. 64496-64511 is the RFC 5398 documentation range, which suggests synthetic data. |
| `pair_socket` | `pair_socket` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | high | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | 'src_ip:src_port->dst_ip:dst_port' string. Fully derivable (verified: 0 mismatches). |
| `pair_ip` | `pair_ip` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | high | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | 'src_ip->dst_ip' string. Derivable. |
| `device_ip_addr` | `exporter_ip` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | medium | provenance | IP of the device (router/sensor) that exported the flow. Real networks have a handful; mock data has ~58k (random). |
| `ip_version` | `ip_version` | SMALLINT | **UNVERIFIED** | high | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | IP version. Constant 4. |
| `ip_version_name` | `ip_version_name` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | high | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | Text form of ip_version. Redundant. |
| `ip_version_id` | `ip_version_id` | SMALLINT | **UNVERIFIED** | high | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | Duplicate of ip_version. |
| `ip_class_of_service` | `ip_class_of_service` | SMALLINT | **UNVERIFIED** | medium | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | QoS marking. Values {0,8,...,56,46} are DSCP code points (46 = Expedited Forwarding), not the raw ToS byte. Uniform in mock data; revisit with real data. |
| `ip_protocol_id` | `protocol` | SMALLINT | **UNVERIFIED** | high | feature | IANA protocol number: 1 ICMP, 6 TCP, 17 UDP. |
| `ip_protocol_full_name` | `protocol_full_name` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | high | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | Text form of protocol. Redundant. |
| `ip_protocol_name` | `protocol_name` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | high | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | Short text form of protocol (TCP/UDP/ICMP). Redundant; kept for readable reports. |
| `next_hop_id_addr` | `next_hop_ip` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | medium | provenance | Next-hop router IP (ipNextHopIPv4Address). Random in mock data. |
| `observation_domain_id` | `observation_domain_id` | INTEGER | **UNVERIFIED** | high | provenance | IPFIX observation domain: which metering process/line card on the exporter saw the flow. |
| `packet_length` | `packet_length` | INTEGER | **UNVERIFIED** | low | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | UNKNOWN exact semantics. Tracks bytes/packets within ~12% on average (corr 0.97) but is not equal to it. Excluded; use num_bytes/num_packets instead. |
| `icmp_type_id` | `icmp_type` | SMALLINT | **UNVERIFIED** | high | feature | ICMP type (0 echo reply, 3 dest unreachable, 8 echo request, 11 time exceeded). -1 = not ICMP. |
| `ingress_id` | `ingress_if` | INTEGER | **UNVERIFIED** | high | provenance | Input interface index (ingressInterface / SNMP ifIndex) on the exporter. |
| `egress_id` | `egress_if` | INTEGER | **UNVERIFIED** | high | provenance | Output interface index. ingress == egress (hairpin) occurs in 935 mock flows. |
| `tcp_flag` | `tcp_flags` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | low | derive | TCP flags as a text label (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK, PSH-ACK, FIN-ACK, ACK-PSH-FIN, RST); NULL for UDP/ICMP. In standard NetFlow this is the OR of every flag seen in the flow, but mock 'SYN' flows carry a median of 14 packets, so here it may be a single sampled packet. Parsed into flag bits; features built on it must hold under both readings. |
| `num_bytes` | `bytes` | BIGINT | **UNVERIFIED** | high | feature | Bytes in the flow, one direction (octetDeltaCount). Flows are unidirectional: no reverse flows exist. |
| `num_packets` | `packets` | BIGINT | **UNVERIFIED** | high | feature | Packets in the flow, one direction (packetDeltaCount). |
| `ttl_min` | `ttl_min` | SMALLINT | **UNVERIFIED** | high | feature | Minimum IP TTL seen. Values 32/64/128 hint at the sender's OS family (Linux 64, Windows 128). |
| `ttl_max` | `ttl_max` | SMALLINT | **UNVERIFIED** | high | feature | Maximum IP TTL seen. Never below ttl_min (verified). |
| `flow_start_time` | `flow_start` | TIMESTAMPTZ | **UNVERIFIED** | high | feature | First packet time, UTC. Nanoseconds in source are truncated to microseconds. |
| `flow_end_time` | `flow_end` | TIMESTAMPTZ | **UNVERIFIED** | high | derive | Last packet time, UTC. Never before flow_start (verified). |
| `flow_end_reason` | `flow_end_reason` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | medium | feature | Why the exporter closed the flow (IPFIX flowEndReason): idle_timeout, active_timeout, end_of_flow (FIN/RST seen), forced_end. In mock data it is independent of the TCP flags, which it should not be. |
| `flow_sequence` | `flow_sequence` | BIGINT | **UNVERIFIED** | medium | provenance | Export sequence counter. Globally unique 1..60000 in mock data; real exporters restart it per exporter/domain. |
| `flow_set_id` | `flow_set_id` | INTEGER | **UNVERIFIED** | high | provenance | NetFlow v9/IPFIX template (FlowSet) ID; data templates use 256+ (mock range 256-1023 matches). |
| `flow_length` | `duration_ms_reported` | BIGINT | **UNVERIFIED** | high | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | Equals (flow_end - flow_start) in milliseconds (corr 1.0). NOT a byte length. Redundant with derived duration. |
| `vlad_id` | `vlan_id` | INTEGER | **UNVERIFIED** | medium | provenance | VLAN ID ('vlad' looks like a typo for 'vlan'). Values 1-300. |
| `vlad_id_dot` | `vlan_id_dot1q` | DOUBLE | **UNVERIFIED** | medium | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | 802.1Q VLAN ID stored as float; always equals vlan_id in mock data. |
| `vlad_id_customer` | `vlan_id_customer` | INTEGER | **UNVERIFIED** | low | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | Customer VLAN (QinQ inner tag). 66% of mock values exceed 4094, the maximum valid VLAN ID, so the values are not trustworthy. |
| `time_stamp` | `export_time` | TIMESTAMPTZ | **UNVERIFIED** | medium | provenance | Probably when the record was exported/observed: flow_end + 0-2 s in mock data. |
| `time_code` | `time_code` | VARCHAR | **UNVERIFIED** | unknown | **DO NOT USE FOR FEATURES** | UNKNOWN. Mixes UTC / FLOW_END / INGEST / EXPORT. Not a timezone. Carried through but never modelled. |
